title: Unit 1 · a
description: 15 câu · cat · ant · yak · ax · Nghe, nhìn tranh, phân loại, xếp thứ tự, nối cặp.

items.title: Unit 1 · a
items.prompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.spokenPrompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: Titi said “cat”. Match the whole spoken word to its picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2 · Unit 1 · centre practice

items.title: Unit 1 · a
items.prompt: Look at the picture. Choose the correct word.
items.spokenPrompt: Look at the picture. Choose the correct word.
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: This picture shows “ant”. Read every letter, including the ending.

items.title: Unit 1 · a
items.prompt: Which word belongs to this spelling group?
items.spokenPrompt: Which word belongs to this spelling group?
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.

items.title: Unit 1 · a
items.scene: Listen, then put the cards in order.
items.prompt: Tap the words in the order you hear them.
items.spokenPrompt: Tap the words in the order you hear them.
items.hint: Listen to the first word, then the second and third. Tap a placed card to undo it.
items.why: The spoken order is: cat, ant, yak.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2 · Unit 1 · centre practice
